Temperature to convert, in the scale chosen below.
What the entered value represents. The relations only hold for pure sine waves.
Known value of the power factor, sine, tangent or angle.
What the entered value represents (angle between 0° and 90°).
Battery capacity in Ah. Leave blank to convert from kWh.
Energy in kWh; used if the capacity is blank.
Nominal voltage of the battery or bank.
Rating of the three-phase bank. Leave blank to convert from µF.
Capacitance of each capacitor in the bank; used if the power is blank.
In delta each capacitor sees the line voltage and needs a third of the capacitance.
Rotational speed in revolutions per minute.
Optional: pulley or wheel diameter for the tangential speed.
Frequency in Hz or angular velocity in rad/s.
From delta to star or the other way round.
In delta, the resistance between the given nodes; in star, the one on that node\'s branch.
Cross-section in mm² or kcmil. Leave blank to convert from AWG.
AWG number; for 1/0, 2/0, 3/0 and 4/0 use 0, −1, −2 and −3.
Converts power between W, kW, MW, HP, CV, BTU/h and kcal/h.
Converts lengths between metric and imperial units.
Converts energy between J, Wh, kWh, calories and BTU.
Converts pressure between Pa, bar, atm, psi, mmHg and kgf/cm².
Converts magnetic flux density between tesla and gauss.
Converts torque between N·m, kgf·m and lbf·ft.
Converts data amounts in decimal (kB, MB) and binary (KiB, MiB) units.
Converts angles between degrees, radians, gradians and turns.
Converts temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.
Relates the RMS, peak, peak-to-peak and average values of a sinusoidal voltage.
Converts between the phase angle and its cosine, sine and tangent.
Converts a battery\'s capacity in Ah to energy in kWh, or the other way round, using its voltage.
Converts the reactive power of a three-phase capacitor bank to the capacitance of each capacitor, or the other way round.
Converts rotational speed in rpm to rad/s and Hz, and to tangential speed if you give the diameter.
Converts between frequency and angular velocity: ω = 2πf.
Transforms three resistances or impedances from delta to the equivalent star, or the other way round (Kennelly).
Converts conductor cross-sections between mm², kcmil and AWG using the AWG gauge definition.
